senses.gloss:
1 Passion, sentiment.
--2
Singing, music.
--3 (In music) A
Rāga in which six of the seven
primary notes are used, औडवः
पंचभिः प्रोक्तः स्वरैः षड्भिस्तु षाडवः.

षाड्गुण्यं [षड् गुणा एव ष्यञ्]
1
The collection of six
qualities.
--2 Six expedients to
be used by a king, six measures
of royal policy; षाड्गुण्यमुपयुंजीत
शक्त्यपेक्षी रसायनं Śi. 2. 93; see
under गुण also.
--3 Multiplication
of anything by six.
--4 Six
[]
properties.
--Comp.
--प्रयोगः
employment of the six expedients or
measures of royal policy.
